limitations.note: Company FCF is a cash-flow measure after cash PPE and lease principal. It is not audited FCFF or Buffett owner earnings. Maintenance/growth capex split, sustainable tax rate, operating working-capital conventions, interest adjustments, future SBC/dilution treatment and discount rate are not supplied. Missing does not mean zero. This is no gate on useful qualitative analysis or a labeled scenario.
Use Sept 30 cash/debt observation plus separately dated November financing. Do not present Sept cash minus debt as Dec net cash; Q4 cash uses and cash generation are unknown here.

No SaaS subscription NDR, logo churn, CAC payback or customer-level LTV is invented. Advertiser retention/cohort data are not disclosed in this packet. DAP growth and ARPP are aggregate engagement/monetization, not retention.

2,572m Q3 weighted-average diluted shares are a scenario denominator, not actual shares outstanding. 2,520,527,597 Oct 24 actual A+B shares are an earlier capitalisation proxy. Do not combine A-only shares with group earnings.
This research was retrieved in 2026 from source-dated pre-cutoff documents. It does not claim preservation of a 2025 browse session. Later search results were screened out.
SBC is included in GAAP costs and added back in CFO. Method must separately choose and disclose dilution or economic-cost treatment, avoiding an automatic double penalty.
Cash finance-lease principal is included. Bond debt excludes lease liabilities. No claim of complete all-in enterprise value or complete economic net debt.

formula_conventions.cash_outflows: positive magnitudes except signed segment operating losses
formula_conventions.ttm: FY2024 + nine months 2025 - nine months 2024; never mix one quarter with nine months
formula_conventions.fcf: CFO - cash PPE outflow - finance lease principal
formula_conventions.cash_capex: cash PPE outflow + finance lease principal
formula_conventions.price_conditional: Use verified raw 2025-12-31 close $660.09. If unavailable on a later host, retain P as variable and label multiples/MOS price-conditional.
formula_conventions.capitalization: P * shares with point date/scope shown; do not infer exact Dec 31 share count
formula_conventions.dcf: Any r, terminal growth, future growth, normalized margin, maintenance capex and dilution denominator are method assumptions, not these source facts
